g.aria-label: (a) Stateless step_fn(ids): Re-Reads Growing Prefix at Every Step → O(T²)
Total cell updates = 1 + 2 + … + T = T(T + 1) / 2 = O(T²) wasted work!
(b) Stateful Recurrent Carry (predict): Carries 512-Byte State Hₜ → O(T)
1 cell update per token (O(T) total) · constant 512-byte state memory!
